session_summary: Enhanced project documentation with an AI Meta-Prompt and improved the Chat Simulator UX. Significantly refactored the container deployment architecture to use secure volume mounts for configuration.
technical_details: Implemented an interval-based state in ChatSimulator.tsx to cycle through command triggers in the input placeholder. Updated compose.yaml to mount config.json as read-only. Standardized server.js across the gateway and main server to handle the new configuration loading logic. Added AI_SUMMARY.json as a required manifest for AI session memory.
